data.title: 美杜莎 Rider · 书店文库本的站立阅读
data.description: 书店角落，她戴着眼镜站在文库本书架前静静翻阅，长发垂落遮出私密的空间；店员经过时她礼貌地让出半步，全程没有一句话却气场安定。
data.action: 书店角落，她戴着眼镜站在文库本书架前静静翻阅，长发垂落遮出私密的空间
data.promptProse: Between tall bookstore shelves, Medusa supports a small paperback by its spine with one hand and turns a page with the other. Thoughtful violet eyes show above her low reading glasses, very long purple hair falling beside a black long-sleeved knit top and ankle-length purple skirt. The medium view uses book spines to enclose the quiet corner. Warm shelf light brightens page edges and hair, leaving deep shaded gaps between the stacked volumes.
